# routeros_disk (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_disk" "disk" {
  comment         = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  compress        = true
  crypted_backend = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `compress` (Boolean) Enables transparent compression on the file system of this device.
- `crypted_backend` (String) The slot of the drive or partition that holds the encrypted data when `type` is `crypted`.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `encryption_key` (String, Sensitive) The key used to unlock an encrypted device (`type` is `crypted`).
- `file_offset` (String) The offset, in bytes, inside the backing file at which the device starts.
- `file_path` (String) The path of the backing file when `type` is `file`.
- `file_size` (String) The size of the backing file when `type` is `file`. Accepts a byte count, a value with a `K`, `M`, `G` or `T` suffix, or `auto`.
- `iscsi_address` (String) The address of the iSCSI target this device connects to.
- `iscsi_export` (Boolean) Exports this device as an iSCSI target.
- `iscsi_iqn` (String) The iSCSI qualified name of the remote target.
- `iscsi_port` (Number) The TCP port of the remote iSCSI target.
- `iscsi_server_iqn` (String) The iSCSI qualified name announced when this device is exported as a target.
- `iscsi_server_port` (Number) The TCP port this device listens on when it is exported as an iSCSI target.
- `media_interface` (String) The interface used by the dynamic `/ip/media` instance created for this device.
- `media_sharing` (Boolean) Enables media (DLNA) sharing of this device.
- `mount_filesystem` (Boolean) Whether the file system found on this device is mounted.
- `mount_point_template` (String) The template used to build the mount point. Supports the `[slot]`, `[model]`, `[serial]`, `[fs-label]`, `[fs-uuid]` and `[fs]` variables.
- `mount_read_only` (Boolean) Mounts the file system read-only.
- `nfs_address` (String) The address of the NFS server this device mounts a share from.
- `nfs_share` (String) The remote folder mounted from the NFS server.
- `nfs_sharing` (Boolean) Exports this device over NFS.
- `nvme_tcp_address` (String) The address of the NVMe over TCP target this device connects to.
- `nvme_tcp_export` (Boolean) Exports this device as an NVMe over TCP target.
- `nvme_tcp_host_name` (String) The initiator host name used to identify this device to the NVMe over TCP target.
- `nvme_tcp_nqn` (String) The NVMe qualified name of the remote target.
- `nvme_tcp_password` (String, Sensitive) The password used to authenticate against the remote NVMe over TCP target.
- `nvme_tcp_port` (Number) The TCP port of the remote NVMe over TCP target.
- `nvme_tcp_server_allow_host_name` (Boolean) Restricts the exported NVMe over TCP target to the initiators announcing the configured host name.
- `nvme_tcp_server_nqn` (String) The NVMe qualified name announced when this device is exported as a target.
- `nvme_tcp_server_password` (String, Sensitive) The password the initiators have to supply to reach the exported target.
- `nvme_tcp_server_port` (Number) The TCP port the exported NVMe over TCP target listens on.
- `parent` (String) The slot of the parent device. Used, for example, when a partition is created on an existing drive.
- `partition_number` (Number) The number of the partition inside the parent device.
- `partition_offset` (String) The offset, in bytes, at which the partition starts inside the parent device, or `auto` to let the system place it.
- `partition_size` (String) The size of the partition, in bytes or with a `K`, `M`, `G` or `T` suffix.
- `raid_chunk_size` (String) The size of the chunks or stripes used by the RAID array.
- `raid_device_count` (Number) The number of devices that make up the RAID array.
- `raid_master` (String) The slot of the RAID array this device is a member of. `none` if it is not a member.
- `raid_max_component_size` (String) The maximum amount of space used on each member of the RAID array, or `none` for no limit.
- `raid_member_failed` (Boolean) Marks this member of a RAID array as failed.
- `raid_role` (String) The position of this device inside the RAID array: the index of the member, or `spare` for a hot spare.
- `raid_type` (String) The RAID level of the array.
  * 0;
  * 1;
  * 4;
  * 5;
  * 6;
  * linear.
- `ramdisk_size` (String) The size of the RAM block device when `type` is `ramdisk`.
- `self_encryption_password` (String, Sensitive) The password of a TCG OPAL self-encrypting drive.
- `slot` (String) The name of the slot. For physical drives it is derived from the connection location, for the devices created here it is the name of the new device.
- `smb_address` (String) The address of the SMB server this device mounts a share from.
- `smb_encryption` (Boolean) Requires encryption on the SMB connection to the remote share.
- `smb_password` (String, Sensitive) The password used to mount the remote SMB share.
- `smb_server_encryption` (Boolean) Requires encryption from the clients of the SMB share exported by this device.
- `smb_server_password` (String, Sensitive) The password the clients have to supply to reach the exported SMB share.
- `smb_server_user` (String) The user the clients have to authenticate as to reach the exported SMB share.
- `smb_share` (String) The name of the remote SMB share that is mounted.
- `smb_sharing` (Boolean) Exports this device over SMB.
- `smb_user` (String) The user name used to mount the remote SMB share.
- `sshfs_address` (String) The address of the SSH server this device mounts a directory from.
- `sshfs_password` (String, Sensitive) The password used to authenticate against the SSH server.
- `sshfs_path` (String) The remote directory mounted over SSHFS.
- `sshfs_port` (Number) The TCP port of the remote SSH server.
- `sshfs_user` (String) The user name used to authenticate against the SSH server.
- `swap` (Boolean) Uses this device, partition or file as swap space.
- `tmpfs_max_size` (String) The maximum amount of RAM used by a `tmpfs` device. Defaults to half of the available RAM when it is not set.
- `type` (String) The kind of device this entry represents.
  * crypted - an encrypted device on top of `crypted_backend`;
  * file - a device backed by a file;
  * hardware - a physical drive detected by the system;
  * iscsi - a remote iSCSI target;
  * nfs - a remote NFS share;
  * nvme-tcp - a remote NVMe over TCP target;
  * partition - a partition of another device;
  * raid - a software RAID array;
  * ramdisk - a RAM backed block device;
  * smb - a remote SMB share;
  * sshfs - a remote directory mounted over SSH;
  * tmpfs - a RAM backed file system.

### Read-Only

- `acquired` (Boolean) Whether the device is claimed by another subsystem, such as a RAID array.
- `block_device` (Boolean) Whether the entry represents a block device.
- `empty` (Boolean) Whether the device has no file system on it.
- `encrypted` (Boolean) Whether the device holds encrypted content.
- `formatting` (Boolean) Whether a format operation is currently running on this device.
- `free` (String) The free space of the file system, in bytes.
- `fs` (String) The file system detected on the device.
- `fs_label` (String) The label of the file system on the device.
- `fs_uuid` (String) The UUID of the file system on the device.
- `guid_partition_table` (Boolean) Whether the device carries a GPT partition table.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `interface` (String) The hardware interface the drive is attached through, for example `PCIe 4x8 GT/s`.
- `model` (String) The model reported by the drive.
- `mount_point` (String) The directory the file system is mounted at.
- `mounted` (Boolean) Whether the file system of this device is currently mounted.
- `nvme_tcp_secret` (String, Sensitive) The generated secret used by the NVMe over TCP initiator.
- `nvme_tcp_server_secret` (String, Sensitive) The generated secret used by the exported NVMe over TCP target.
- `partition` (Boolean) Whether the entry is a partition of another device.
- `raid_member` (Boolean) Whether this device is a member of a RAID array.
- `raid_member_state` (String) The state of this device inside the RAID array.
- `raid_uuid` (String) The UUID of the RAID array.
- `self_encrypted_and_locked` (Boolean) Whether a self-encrypting drive is currently locked.
- `self_encryption_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the self-encryption of the drive is enabled.
- `self_encryption_supported` (Boolean) Whether the drive supports TCG OPAL self-encryption.
- `serial` (String) The serial number reported by the drive.
- `size` (String) The size of the device, in bytes.
- `slot_default` (String) The default slot name of a physical drive.
- `sshfs_local_user` (String) The local user the SSHFS mount runs as.
- `state` (String) The current state of the device.
- `swap_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the device is currently active as swap space.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/disk get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_disk.disk "*1"
```
